params.name: address
params.description:
Comma separated list. Address of sender or recipient of any in/out transaction related
to the action.

params.name: txid
params.description: ID of any in/out tx related to the action

params.name: asset
params.description:
Comma separated list. Any asset that is part of the action (CHAIN.SYMBOL)
Additionally, synth, nosynth, and norune filters can be used for swap, add/withdraw actions.

params.name: type
params.description:
One or more comma separated unique types of action
(swap, addLiquidity, withdraw, donate, refund, switch, thorname, runePoolDeposit, runePoolWithdraw)

params.name: txType
params.description:
One or more comma separated transaction type of the action, it's the tx type parsed
from memo. For example: Loan is a swap event but it's considered as loan tx type
Type of Transactions: 
"unknown", "add", "withdraw", "swap", "limitOrder", "outbound", "donate",
"bond", "unbond", "leave", "yggdrasilFund", "yggdrasilReturn", "reserve",
"refund", "migrate", "ragnarok", "switch", "noOp", "consolidate", "thorname",
"loanOpen", "loanRepayment"

params.name: affiliate
params.description: Comma separated list. Affiliate address of the action (swap, refund)

params.name: limit
params.description: number of actions returned, default is 50

params.name: nextPageToken
params.description: if this is given, the actions for the next page will be given

params.name: timestamp
params.description: if this is given, the actions older than the timestamp will be given

params.name: height
params.description: if this is given, the actions older than the height will be given

params.name: prevPageToken
params.description: if this is given, the actions for the previous page will be given

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: if this is given, the actions newer than the timestamp will be given

params.name: fromHeight
params.description: if this is given, the actions newer than the height will be given

items.docs:
List actions along with their related transactions. An action is generated by one or more
inbound transactions with the intended action set in the transaction memo. The action may
result in one or more outbound transactions. Results are paginated by sets of 50.
Filters may be applied to query actions.
